subject: Error uploading app: "Error pulling repository: pull: invalid character '5' after top-level value"

messages.author: e078464ca3d57771
messages.subject: Error uploading app: "Error pulling repository: pull: invalid character '5' after top-level value"
parts:
When I try to upload my app, I get the following:

> shinyapps::deployApp(appName='abtest')
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://polimath.shinyapps.io/abtest? [Y/n] y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 11351...
Waiting for task: 77811
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building package: digest (0.6.4)
################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 77813 error: Unhandled Exception: Error pulling repository: pull: invalid character '5' after top-level value

The app works locally.  The app does not use any packages but does load data from two text files. These files are in the same directory as ui.R and server.R.  I've tried reencoding the data and .R files as ASCII; same problem.  I tried encoding all the files as UTF-8 and adding an .Renviron file specifying the encoding; same problem.

Thoughts?
